body: Airbus is aiming to make 259 commercial aircraft deliveries across November and December 2026 to reach its annual target of around 870 units. On November 6, 2026, Airbus confirmed that it had made 74 aircraft deliveries to 45 customers in October, bringing the year's running total to 621. While delivering its nine-month review on October 28, 2026, Airbus reaffirmed its ambition to deliver around 870 aircraft in 2026.

Split between November and December, Airbus will need to deliver around 124 to 125 aircraft each month. Its highest monthly total this year was 89, in June. In December 2025, the company delivered 136 aircraft; its highest ever monthly total was 138, in December 2019, and across November and December 2019 it delivered 216 aircraft, its highest total over two consecutive months. To match last year's total of 793 commercial aircraft, Airbus would need to deliver 172 more before the end of 2026.

Among the notable deliveries in October 2026 was KLM Royal Dutch Airlines' first Airbus A350, named 'The Night Watch'. Other airlines to have received A350s include Starlux Airlines, ITA Airways, Emirates and Etihad Airways. IndiGo received seven aircraft during the month, while Delta Air Lines added five jets to its fleet and American Airlines and Etihad Airways received four each. In October, Airbus landed 202 commercial aircraft orders: Aviation Capital Group and Avolon both ordered 75 aircraft, comprised of Airbus A320neos and A321neos; Biman Bangladesh Airlines ordered six A321neos and four A350-900s; Atlantic Airways purchased two A320neos; and an undisclosed customer ordered five A321neos.
en.summary: Airbus delivered 74 aircraft in October, bringing its 2026 total to 621; it needs 259 more deliveries in November and December to reach its target of around 870 for the year.
en.title: Airbus aims for 259 aircraft deliveries before year end to reach annual target

body: 空中巴士力拚在2026年11、12月交付259架商用飛機，以達成全年約870架的目標。空中巴士11月6日確認，10月共向45家客戶交付74架飛機，全年累計交付量達到621架。空中巴士在10月28日公布前9個月業績時重申，全年交付約870架飛機的目標不變。
要在年底前達標，空中巴士11、12月每月需交付約124至125架飛機；今年單月最高交付量為6月的89架。2025年12月空中巴士交付136架飛機；史上單月最高紀錄則是2019年12月的138架，2019年11、12月合計交付216架，是史上連續兩個月最高總量。若要追平去年全年的793架，空中巴士年底前還需交付172架。

10月值得注意的交付包括荷蘭皇家航空首架空中巴士A350，命名為「夜巡」；星宇航空、義大利航空、阿聯酋航空與阿提哈德航空10月也接收A350。印度靛藍航空10月接收7架飛機，達美航空增加5架，美國航空與阿提哈德航空各接收4架。訂單方面，空中巴士10月共獲得202架商用飛機訂單，包括航空資本集團與Avolon各75架A320neo與A321neo，孟加拉航空訂購6架A321neo與4架A350-900，大西洋航空訂購2架A320neo，另有一家未公開客戶訂購5架A321neo。
zh.summary: 空中巴士10月交付74架飛機，全年累計621架；要在11、12月再交259架才能達到全年約870架的目標，單月需交約124至125架，遠高於今年單月最高的89架。
zh.title: 空中巴士力拚年底前再交259架飛機，挑戰全年約870架目標
